latest_release.name: v1.0.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* 1.0.2-dev version increment by @jkirk5 in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1214
* Cleaned up a warning message when using fixed throttle allocation for multi-engine. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1207
* Moved the total nacelle wetted area calc into its own component. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1210
* Remove ambiance dependency from OpenAeroStruct wing mass example by @zain-asif-dev in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1216
* Simplified API for input/output helper functions by @jkirk5 in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1206
* Phase linking overhaul. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1203
* Remove Wing area from Simple Landing builder defaults by @cmbenne3 in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1215
* Made phase_info.py file, generated by Mission GUI, more readable by @hschilling in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1217
* Gravity update foundation by @ehariton in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1219
* Gravity v2 - Mars + Earth Radius Update by @ehariton in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1227
* Gravity v3 - FLOPS Gravity, Earth Radius values updated by @ehariton in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1232
* Sea Level Density overhaul -> Requires OpenMDAO bugfix by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1233
* Tweaking the 2dof problem types benchmark to get past CI. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1241
* updates to fix engine scaling index bug by @cmbenne3 in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1246
* Support `needs_mission_solver` in custom engine models. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1243
* GASP geom GASPEngineSize component split by @xjjiang in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1230
* converted BAGGAGE_MASS_PER_PASSENGER, MASS_PER_PASSENGER, MASS_PER_PASSENGER_WITH_BAGS to variables by @xjjiang in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1238
* Ia376 option usage vis by @hschilling in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1244
* Convert Aircraft.Engine.REFERENCE_SLS_THRUST to a variable by @xjjiang in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1249
* Unify PreMissionGroup and PostMissionGroup into a single group. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1248
* GASP mass fixed.py and fuel.py updates by @xjjiang in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1228
* Fuselage layout enhancement and modification by @xjjiang in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1205
* Add a unit test for non-zero Aircraft.CrewPayload.ULD_MASS_PER_PASSENGER by @xjjiang in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1240
* GASP multiengine fixes by @jkirk5 in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1252
* Improve handling of multivalue defaults. by @Kenneth-T-Moore in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1253
* Gravity v4  by @ehariton in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1235
* 1.0.2 release by @jkirk5 in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1255

## New Contributors
* @zain-asif-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/pull/1216

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OpenMDAO/Aviary/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2
